chain_words.nuance: wanting to rest after some activity
tired of something that lasts a long time
tired in a physical or mental way that affects performance
completely tired with no energy left
emptied of all energy and strength

explanation: These words all express tiredness, from simply wanting rest to having no energy left at all.

usage_notes.difference: 'Tired' describes a normal need for rest; 'exhausted' describes a much stronger state where a person has no energy left.
